note: Fifth screening, whole games to their end (day limit 300) against Nullkiller2 - for the first time on fresh maps: six maps each of the templates Blockbuster M and Long Run M of pool fresh1, both seats, 24 games per configuration, 384 in all. Base: the defaults of 20.11. F - guard fights judged by the simulated battle, level 2 (level 1 in screening 4: +0.07 +- 0.08, 29 instead of 42 games lost). R - the second army a third time. S - threatSpend 2. D - tour. K - the two further battle plans against guards. B - breakout 3. A and Q - the hero itself, new in this screening: in the lost games of screening 4 our main army is larger than the enemy's until day 100 (142,000 against 92,000 on day 56) and still stands at twice the strongest enemy hero on 13 of the days 29 to 84 only (27 in won games) - the enemy's hero counts for more (level 12.9 against 10.3 on day 56; in six probe games attack plus defence 16.3 against 12.8 on day 84). A = artifactCare: artifacts are valued by what they do for their bearer, worn best per slot, handed on when heroes meet. Q = skillChoice + primaryByArmy: secondary skills by role and army, points of attack and defence by the army led. The daily timeline now also holds the strongest hero's attack, defence, power, knowledge, artifacts worn and fighting factor (fields 14 to 19). Design: eight switches or groups of switches on the base {}, 2^(8-4) resolution IV, shared pool; F = fightForecast 2 + forecastPlans 1; R = secondArmy 1 + secondArmyEdge 0.6; S = threatSpend 2; D = tour 1; K = kitePlan 1 + latePlan 1; B = breakout 3; A = artifactCare 1; Q = skillChoice 1 + primaryByArmy 1.
